description: This file defines the Affiliate model for the Opencart e-commerce platform, containing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve affiliate records, as well as manage affiliate reports.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: A model class representing affiliate-related database operations within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Creates a new affiliate record in the database for a specified customer, generating a tracking token, and optionally adding approval if configured.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates existing affiliate record data for a specified customer.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Removes the affiliate record associated with a specific customer and deletes related reports.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves the affiliate record for a particular customer, decoding custom fields if present.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Finds and returns affiliate details based on a tracking code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Logs an affiliate report entry with customer id, IP, and country.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all affiliate reports for a particular customer.
